databaseRule.thresholdHours: Alert when the last good backup is older than (hours)

hint.database_disk_high: Fires while the data disk is at or above this percentage. Leave 0 for the default (85).
hint.database_connections_high: Fires while open connections are at or above this percentage of the limit. Leave 0 for the default (80).
hint.database_down: Fires while the database is not accepting connections.
hint.database_backup_stale: Fires when the newest successful backup is older than this. Leave 0 for the default (26 hours).

backup_failed.label: Backup failed
backup_failed.description: Fires when a scheduled backup does not complete.
backup_failed.action: Open the failed backup run to read its error, fix the cause, then run a backup to confirm it succeeds.

deploy_failed.label: Deploy failed
deploy_failed.description: Fires when a deploy stops before the new release serves traffic.
deploy_failed.action: Read the deploy's logs to see why it stopped, fix the cause, then deploy again.

database_down.label: Database down
database_down.description: Fires while the database is not accepting connections.
database_down.action: Check the database's logs and restart it if it has stopped.

database_backup_stale.label: Database backup stale
database_backup_stale.description: Fires when the newest successful backup is older than the limit you set.
database_backup_stale.action: Check the database's backup schedule and recent backup runs, then run a backup now.

database_disk_high.label: Database disk high
database_disk_high.description: Fires while the database's data disk is at or above the threshold.
database_disk_high.action: Free space on the data disk or grow it before the database runs out of room.

database_connections_high.label: Database connections high
database_connections_high.description: Fires while open connections are close to the database's limit.
database_connections_high.action: Look for idle or leaked connections in your apps, or raise the connection limit.

node_disk_space.label: Node disk space
node_disk_space.description: Fires when a node's disk is nearly full.
node_disk_space.action: Remove unused images and old logs on the node, or move workloads to another node.

email_delivery_failing.label: Email delivery failing
email_delivery_failing.description: Fires while outbound emails keep failing to send.
email_delivery_failing.action: Check the email provider's settings and recent delivery errors, then send a test email.

budgetThreshold.hint: Fires while any project or team budget (Usage and cost) has reached its warning level, gone over its limit, or is forecast to overrun this month. It notifies again only when a new level is crossed.

alerts.noChannelWarning: No notification channel is set, so this rule will fire without notifying anyone. Choose a channel above, or connect one in Settings > Notification channels.
